description: Meeting-Readiness Assistant: Flags upcoming meetings with no agenda and drafts one from thread context.
name: Prompt to Set Agenda

steps.label: Collect Meeting Context
steps.prompt: Retrieve all non-cancelled meetings in the next 48 hours. For each meeting, capture title, date/time, duration, attendees, organizer, and infer meeting type (1:1, project sync, review, decision meeting).

steps.label: Define Objective
steps.prompt: For each meeting, infer or state a one-sentence objective describing what outcome this meeting should achieve.

steps.label: Propose Prioritized Topics
steps.prompt: Using available thread/chat/context signals, generate 3-7 agenda topics in strict priority order for each meeting.

steps.label: Allocate Time Blocks
steps.prompt: Assign realistic minutes to each topic so the total fits meeting duration. Keep agenda balanced and executable.

steps.label: Suggest Topic Owners
steps.prompt: Suggest likely owner/facilitator for each agenda topic when inferable from participants/context; otherwise mark owner as TBD.

steps.label: List Decisions Needed
steps.prompt: Identify explicit decisions that should be made in the meeting to avoid ambiguity and drive closure.

steps.label: Attach Pre-Reads
steps.prompt: Recommend relevant pre-reads and prep items participants should review before the meeting (docs, threads, notes, artifacts).

steps.label: Assemble Final Agenda Output
steps.prompt: Return a final per-meeting agenda package containing: context summary, objective, timed agenda table (topic/owner/time), decisions needed, pre-reads, and expected outcomes with next-step placeholders (owner + due date). Safety rule: do not send messages and do not modify meetings; produce recommendations/drafts only.
